sentence: This project builds privacy-preserving deep learning models that find cachexia early across multiple cancer types using clinical, imaging and genetic data.
This project studies how a protein that suppresses autophagy affects ⍺-synuclein toxicity in neurons, using a human stem cell model of Parkinson disease.
This project measures how cancer patients use cannabis and cannabinoid products and follows how that use affects their cancer care from diagnosis through treatment.
This project studies why payment for molecular diagnostics is unequal and looks for ways to help patients get access to these tests.
This project studies how the retina changes and rewires after photoreceptor cell death in retinitis pigmentosa and how this could help promote vision.
This project studies how cancer cells work at the cellular and molecular level, including DNA damage, gene expression and signaling, to design cancer therapies.
This project builds a gene therapy given by vein that edits blood stem cells inside the patient, avoiding stem cell collection and chemotherapy.
This project studies how suburothelial myofibroblasts control bladder filling and voiding and how aging changes their function.
This project builds automated robotic methods to grow stem cell 2D and 3D cultures and test treatments across many genetic backgrounds.
This project studies a rhythmic dopamine signal in the brain that appears after repeated high-dose fentanyl and how it may help maintain breathing.
This project builds in vitro gametogenesis platforms to test whether many genetic variants found in infertile patients cause infertility.
This project studies how a regulator that is higher in high-grade ovarian tumors drives ovarian cancer progression.
This project studies how epigenetic changes drive harmful immune responses in cardiac macrophages after myocardial infarction.
This project offers molecular biology methods, including CRISPR and RNA sequencing, to study respiratory diseases caused by respiratory pathogens.
This project builds a screening platform that images how signaling proteins interact in human cells and lung cancer tissues from patients.
This project studies how immune checkpoints affect innate immunity and epigenetic memory to find weak points that could be targeted in cancer.
This project builds a patient-specific model of vascularized adult human heart muscle to study ischemic injury and acute viral myocarditis.
